text: Forest Valley Outdoor Centre is located on Toronto and Region Conservation Authority lands in York Centre (Ward 6) and is managed by the City of Toronto. The site has a rich history in which thousands of past and present Torontonians have enjoyed the river, ravines, green space and forests either when it was a privately owned day camp or as a City of Toronto asset. Until recently, the lands were leased seasonally to the Toronto District School Board. At one time, the City of Toronto operated summer day camps on the site. The site also has a wide range of structures and meeting places, which have been used in the past for permitted events. The terms of the ending of the lease agreement with the Toronto District School Board are evolving. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Parks and Recreation, in consultation with the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management and the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority, to, in the event that the current lease between the City of Toronto and the Toronto District School Board is formally terminated, undertake engagement and develop a strategic plan, advised by public consultations - and/or to update any current plans for the site – to ensure the Forest Valley Outdoor Centre remains a well maintained, safe and publicly accessible green space and ravine with an interim update to Infrastructure and Environment Committee by the second quarter of 2027.
